================================================================================
For loop without an in-list, single line
================================================================================

for arg do echo "$arg"; done

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (for_statement
    (variable_name)
    (do_group
      (command
        (command_name
          (word))
        (string
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name)))))))

================================================================================
For loop without an in-list, do on the next line
================================================================================

for arg
do
  echo "$arg"
done

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (for_statement
    (variable_name)
    (do_group
      (command
        (command_name
          (word))
        (string
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name)))))))

================================================================================
For loop without an in-list inside an if branch
================================================================================

if [ -n "$tty" ]; then
  for arg do
    shift
  done
fi

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (if_statement
    (test_command
      (unary_expression
        (test_operator)
        (string
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name)))))
    (for_statement
      (variable_name)
      (do_group
        (command
          (command_name
            (word)))))))

================================================================================
For loop with an in-list keeps its terminator
================================================================================

for x in a b; do echo "$x"; done

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (for_statement
    (variable_name)
    (word)
    (word)
    (do_group
      (command
        (command_name
          (word))
        (string
          (simple_expansion
            (variable_name)))))))
